name: Human Development Index
methodology_note: 'year' is the REPORT year, not the data year: 2014 report uses 2013 data; 2015 report 2014 data; 2016 report (released March 2017) 2015 data; 2018 statistical update 2017 data; 2020 report 2019 data; 2021/22 report (released Sept 2022, labelled 2022) 2021 data; 2023/24 report (released March 2024, labelled 2024) 2022 data; 2025 report 2023 data. UNDP states ranks and HDI values are not comparable across editions because of data revisions. UNDP's comparable revised HDI-value series (via Our World in Data) for India: 2013 0.615, 2015 0.633, 2017 0.649, 2019 0.651, 2021 0.647, 2022 0.676, 2023 0.685. UNDP's 2025 release says India moved from 133 (2022) to 130 (2023) in the revised dataset, which differs from the 134 published in the 2023/24 report. Gaps: 2013 report, 2017 (none), 2019 report (some outlets report 129, unverified here). No government rebuttal located.
